culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Fumie Masuko. Fumie admits she killed the two victims. Charles Abel was actually her husband. During the accident, Tanzawa and Someji had run away without trying to help Abel. Even after all these years, they had no repercussion of their deeds and shamelessly came to unearth the treasure that had once caused their coworker's death. Charles was actually trying to write "metal" ("tetsuno" in Japanese) as he had found a metallic hairpin. As a foreigner, he had never seen one before and after writing "metal", he was trying to show the team the paper and the hairpin to ask them what

motive.quote: But since he wrote with a permanent marker, the ink bled through producing "nue" instead.

method.quote: Faking the Nue The culprit used perspective shift to simulate the enlargement of the size of the nue.

evidence.quote: Clues and Evidence Faking perspective requires the knowledge and experience of an artist.

motive.zhHans: 但由于他用的是永久性马克笔，墨水渗透开来，反而写出了"nue"。她邀请 Hajime 来看他为父亲复仇，尽管她否认 Hajime 是她和 Charles 的儿子。同样，根据一则传说，nue 实际上是 Minamoto Yorimasa 的母亲，她变成这头野兽，好让儿子将其斩杀。漫画到动画的改动 主条目：漫画与动画的差异列表 因为第872集改编了两个文件，第874集只改编了一个文件以及第961号文件的五页。
motive.en: But since he wrote with a permanent marker, the ink bled through producing "nue" instead. She invited Hajime to have him see her avenge his father though she denies that Hajime is her and Charles son. Similarly, according to one legend, the nue was actually the mother of Minamoto Yorimasa, who transformed into the beast so that her son could slay it. Manga to anime changes Main article: List of differences between the manga and anime Because episode 872 adapted two files, episode 874 was adapted from only one file and five pages from file 961.

method.zhHans: 伪装成 Nue 犯人利用透视变化来模拟 nue 体型的增大。犯人使用了一块画有酒店窗户陡峭角度的幕布，并把狗打扮成 nue 的样子。Tanzawa 同样是被下毒的，方法是把双叉毒镖装在软木塞上而不是管子上。凶器是用系在上面的线取回的。犯人很可能训练了那条狗，并在之前来酒店时种下那棵树来遮挡视线。
method.en: Faking the Nue The culprit used perspective shift to simulate the enlargement of the size of the nue. The culprit used a screen with a steep drawing of the windows in the hotel and dressed the dog as the nue. Tanzawa was similarly poisoned by attaching a twin-pronged poison dart to the cork instead of a tube. The weapon was retrieved using a string attached to it. The culprit probably trained the dog and planted the tree to obstruct the view when she came to the hotel before.

evidence.zhHans: 线索与证据 伪装透视需要艺术家的知识和经验。凶器是用系在上面的线取回的。Charles 其实是想写"metal"（日语"tetsuno"），因为他发现了一个金属发夹。
evidence.en: Clues and Evidence Faking perspective requires the knowledge and experience of an artist. The weapon was retrieved using a string attached to it. Charles was actually trying to write "metal" ("tetsuno" in Japanese) as he had found a metallic hairpin.

resolution.zhHans: 江户川柯南和服部平次解释了制造 nue 所用的手法并揭穿了犯人。（见下方"结局"）
resolution.en: Conan and Heiji explain the tricks used to create the nue and expose the culprit. (See Resolution below)

summary.en: The fact that Azusa was an imposter in The Betrayal's Stage is confirmed when Azusa says that she didn't go to the concert hall. However, only Conan and Amuro himself knows that it was actually Vermouth in disguise. Conan thinks that since Vermouth bothered to investigate, the Black Organization must really be interested in the cipher left by Kōji Haneda seventeen years ago. Azusa also reveals that she saw a strange duo in front of Mōri Detective Agency talking something about "cleaning rags".
